DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I sense it... the Black Hole.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I'm ready to open the Black Hole.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Tryon Industries is the future. Without us, Omeda City would be nothing but another stretch of barren wasteland.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: As a child, I dreamed of traveling the stars. Now I hold their power in the palm of my hand.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: People don't always appreciate my honesty.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Shall we show them the power of the stars?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Come dance with me, Dr. Dekker!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: When I finish with you, it'll be as if you never existed.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Tell me. How does it feel to be utterly insignificant?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: You really think you will survive. Astonishing.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Tryon will not forget your aid.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The stars will know your name.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Oh, you think yourself very capable.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: With me on your side, they stand no chance.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Perhaps they will surprise us. Not likely.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Don't slow me down, and this will be over quickly.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: A pack of fools and children. This will be easy.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I had hoped for a greater challenge.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Well, let us rain destruction down upon them.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The stars align. I am ready.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Are you ready to obliterate them?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Hm. Well, I hope you are prepared.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Shinbi, the brightest star of all.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The power of this place... it resonates in my bones.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The culmination of my research. Finally, it bears fruit.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The stars do not demand blood, but I do.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Come back again, so I can crush you once more.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I am filled with the power of the stars!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Not a Tryon product, but perhaps it will be sufficient.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I have enough to spend. Perhaps some new equipment.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: It is time for some improvements.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The stars grant me access to the Black Hole.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The Black Hole is almost mine.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Without your assistance, Dr. Dekker, none of this would have been possible. I am grateful for your help.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The stars have changed me, Dr. Dekker. I am no longer the man you once knew.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I brought us a glorious future, and gave you access to Agora itself. You're welcome.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Ah. I may have touched something.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Dr. Dekker, how is my team at Tryon Industries? Are they faring well?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: You know, we make good partners, Dr. Dekker.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I bought your research, Doctor. It was already mine.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Oh, for bringing about the greatest discovery in Omedan history? I will gladly shoulder that blame.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: This world and its powers are beyond you!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The power of the stars is mine to command!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Oh no, Doctor. I know exactly what I'm doing.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Dr. Maximov. Why have you left your lab? I don't pay you to waste time on Agora.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: When your subjects escaped, my family was able to keep your failures out of the public eye. But Tryon's faith in you wavers.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Oh, Maximov. My mother may be the face of Tryon Industries now, but with this power, I am this company's future.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I thought you preferred your subjects built from scratch, Dr. Maximov.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I funded your research because I believed in your vision, Dr. Maximov. Do not disappoint me.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Just imagine what Tryon Industries could do with the power of the stars.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: We are not colleagues, Dr. Maximov. You are an asset, and I employ my assets however I wish.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: All good things, I'm sure. I'd expect nothing less from my favorite scientist.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The power of the Ashur is mine, Maximov!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: You've failed me for the last time, Maximov!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Don't you dare speak to me about my mother!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Oh, touch me and I'll break off that claw of yours, Maximov!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Such a brilliant mind. But it wasn't enough.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Looks like I'll need to hire someone new.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Beautiful... show me again how you function.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Well. That design could use some improvement.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Zinx. The crown jewel of Maximov's lab. You truly are the perfect specimen.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: There is such elegance in your engineering. Such power and efficiency.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Someday, Zinx, you will come to appreciate the importance of aesthetic as well as function.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I see that emotions are difficult for you to read, Zinx. What you perceive as amusement is clearly appreciation of my greatness.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Maximov gave you such strange powers. Do they serve you well?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Well, it's good to see that one of Maximov's experiments was a success.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Unlike my mother, I enjoy seeing our products implemented in the field.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Why does everyone always tell me this? One can only betray an equal.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Tryon built you, and Tryon shall end you!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Show me the power of a Tryon bioweapon, Zinx!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Money? I am rich with the power of the stars!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I no longer need them. The heavens themselves are at my beck and call!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I order you to... oh gods.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Not even the stars can stop what will happen next.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I'm sure Dr. Dekker believes that the power of the stars should have been hers. But this was no accident. This was destiny.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Ah, peace and quiet. No one around. The perfect environment in which to cultivate a great mind such as my own.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: There are so many things I could do to fill this silence. Perhaps recite the names of the constellations. Or ancient Ashurite deities. Or Tryon Industry products?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: So many things. So many things! Dear gods, please, someone come talk to me! My incredible mind is wasted in this isolation!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I was alone when I opened the first portal to Agora. Part of Dr. Dekker's ship had "accidentally" broken, so she had to leave our temple dig site to repair it. Poor Harue. She had worked hard for me, but I knew this victory was mine alone.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I see. You wish to touch greatness.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Well, greatness is very busy. So begone.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: You are distracting me from my plans! I have machinations in progress. Uh huh. Plans far greater than your tiny mind can comprehend.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: For the last time, begone, you gnat! Or you shall have a meteor for your troubles.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The skies will open, and the heavens themselves will rain destruction upon you! You will feel the endless burning of the stars, and be lost in the cold void of space! I will make you rue your very birth! Prepare yourself, for you have pushed greatness too far! Stop poking me!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: When I was young, I used to watch the night sky. I'd look up at those bright pinpricks of light, through the smog of Omeda City, and dream of leaving everything behind. And then I woke up. I was born to run Tryon Industries and lead us into a new age. I had no time to waste on dreams.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: And yet I could not shake those dreams. I met this woman, Dr. Harue Dekker, who claimed to study the Ashur. Now, she believed that she could solve the mysteries surrounding their ancient civilization... and perhaps provide the key to the planet Agora itself. And when she spoke, I began to dream of the stars again. So I funded her research, and hoped.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: No one to stop us! Let's go!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: They thought they could best us? How arrogant.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I can feel it in my fingers.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Best leave that one for later...

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Ahem. That would not end in my favor.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Why do I idle here? They've moved on without me!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I will not allow anyone to steal my glory. I must move!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I will not be robbed of my rightful prize: the power of the Ashur!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The stars flood me with power!

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Don't ruin everything while I'm gone.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I will only be a moment.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: I'll be back. Hold them until then.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Looks like it's only me now. This will be amusing.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Victory is ours! Did you expect any less?

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: With this power, anything is possible.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: The heavens smile down upon us.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Ashur... grant me knowledge. Grant me more of your power.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Soon, the secrets of the stars will be mine.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: Listen, Dr. Dekker. Do you hear that? It's like there's a voice calling to me.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: This chamber may hold the secrets of the Ashur.

DialogueWave.Name: SpokenText
DialogueWave.Value: This power! What has happened to me?
